name: Slaughter Servitor (Processor)

bonuses.name: Iron Soul
bonuses.text: This Threat is unaffected by Abilities that target the mind, and never needs to make a Resolve Test to continue fighting.

bonuses.name: Coordinated Slaughter
bonuses.text: When this Threat hits a target with its electro-prod, it can then make a single move towards the target and make an attack with its spiker. When performing this attack, this Threat does not suffer any penalties for making a Multi-Attack.

abilities.name: Gristle in the Gears
abilities.text: The Slaughter Servitor is Exhausted for 1 Round. This can be negated by the Slaughter Servitor spending an action and succeeding at a DN 3 Athletics (Str) Test.

note: No Tier row printed; class proposed (5 Wounds, no Champion bonus, a rank-and-file servitor above a Troop). Printed with the Corral and Excoriator under the heading 'Slaughter Servitor'. Weapons print 'Range 1' and 'Range 18'; no Salvo printed.
